issues.title: COA text typed since last lost focus is lost on re-render.
issues.body:
This relates to the issue where `json-editor` is being refreshed when focus changes, or a new message is received.

We cache the text in the editor, and replace that text in the re-render process.

But, we only cache the text on lose focus.  This still means some text can be lost.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/ad23b9f564f0606ad485ffcaa47e3fd2.gif)
